subject: Quick follow-up: SOC 2 packet and blockers for pilot with Lumos Cloud

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick follow-up: SOC 2 packet and blockers for pilot with Lumos Cloud

Hi Elena / Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the time today — I appreciated the candid discussion about Lumos Cloud's pilot goals and risk priorities. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Objective: run a 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost at 2k reqs/min, with limited PHI redaction in scope.
- Main blockers you flagged: SOC 2 evidence review, retention policy alignment, and procurement timeline.
- Action items: I attached the Redwood security packet (Redwood_Security_Packet_v1.pdf) and a short summary of SOC 2 controls; Monica (cc) can walk through the evidence or answer any technical questions.

Requested from you: 1) Please confirm priority/timing for the pilot (still targeting EOY decision?), 2) Any immediate blockers on the packet review (e.g., specific controls you need evidence for), and 3) If helpful, loop in your procurement point of contact so we can align on contract timing.

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d5e-redwood-soc2 (packet)

Proposed next step: 20–30 min call with Monica to go over SOC 2 evidence and data retention (I can host). Are you available next week (Nov 23–25)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Packet_v1.pdf (pdf, 2.3 MB)

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SOC 2 packet and blockers for pilot with Lumos Cloud

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the packet and follow-up. We're mid-review; a couple quick items from our security and legal that would help move things along: 

1) Data retention specifics: can you confirm our options for per-tenant retention windows and automated deletion?
2) Log access/evidence: is there a way for us to get limited-read access to certain audit logs, or would we rely on Redwood-supplied extracts?
3) KMS: do you support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for encryption at rest, or is that on the roadmap?

Procurement note: our internal timeline is still flexible — we may not finalize vendor selection until early Q1 unless the SOC evidence review completes quickly.

Would Monica be available for a short 20-minute call to walk our security engineer through the packet? If yes, please propose 2–3 slots. Looping Priya from procurement so she can chime in on timeline.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Platform Security, Lumos Cloud
elena.morris@lumoscloud.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-25T08:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SOC 2 packet and blockers for pilot with Lumos Cloud

Hi Elena, Rajiv —

Thanks for the specifics — happy to walk through each item. Quick answers up front:

- Retention: Redwood supports per-tenant retention policies today; retention windows can be configured down to 30 days with automated delete. We can also offer longer retention under dedicated/private deployments.
- Audit logs: we can provide curated audit log extracts for customer review; we also support read-only log access for partners in Dedicated configurations.
- KMS: customer-managed keys via common cloud KMS providers are supported in Private/Dedicated; hosted customers can request dedicated encryption keys — full HSM support is on roadmap for 2027.

I've attached a short one-page quick answers file for your security team (SOC2-Quick-Answers.txt). I have availability for 20-min calls: Nov 30 10:00–11:30 PT, Dec 1 9:00–11:00 PT, or Dec 2 13:00–15:00 PT. Please pick a slot that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOC2-Quick-Answers.txt (text, 4 KB)
